rows.name:
The battle between the Chilkins and the Antols rages[XENO:n ]
on. Help the Nopon so they can continue their[XENO:n ]
research of Valak Mountain in peace.
Defeat 5 [System:Color name=item ]Poleaxe Chilkins[/System:Color] on Valak Mountain.
Defeat 5 [System:Color name=item ]Ent Antols[/System:Color] on Valak Mountain.
Return to the researcher.

You defeated some of the warring Chilkins and[XENO:n ]
Antols. Valak Mountain is quieter now.

You've been asked to help the Research Team.[XENO:n ]
Go to areas of Valak Mountain with great views[XENO:n ]
and tell the team your impressions.

Take in the scenery from Befalgar Pedestal on[XENO:n ]
Valak Mountain.

Take in the scenery from Kana Peak on Valak[XENO:n ]
Mountain.
Return to the researcher.

You visited two peaks on Valak Mountain to[XENO:n ]
help the research.

You found a Nopon who is in danger of freezing to[XENO:n ]
death! She might have some useful information.[XENO:n ]
Find some things to warm her up.

Collect 3 [System:Color name=item ]Hox Flints[/System:Color] from Porcu Hoxes on Valak[XENO:n ]
Mountain.

Collect 2 [System:Color name=item ]Antol Fire Pouches[/System:Color] from Ent Antols on[XENO:n ]
Valak Mountain.

Collect 1 [System:Color name=item ]Feris Aged Ale[/System:Color] from a Noto Feris on[XENO:n ]
Valak Mountain.
Return to the collapsed Nopon.

You warmed the Nopon up and she got the[XENO:n ]
information back to the Research Team.

You saved a Nopon that had been kidnapped by[XENO:n ]
Chilkin. However, when the sentry came, the Chilkin[XENO:n ]
rallied. Fight your way out.
Defeat 4 [System:Color name=item ]Cunning Chilkins[/System:Color] on Valak Mountain.
Return to the kidnapped Nopon.

You helped the kidnapped Nopon who took some[XENO:n ]
amazing information to the Research Team.

According to the top-secret information, the Chilkin[XENO:n ]
leader is not around. This is a chance to research the[XENO:n ]
Chilkin Lair.

Investigate the Chilkin Lair in Bagnar Snowfield[XENO:n ]
on Valak Mountain.
Return to Dakuku.

The research trip discovered that the Chilkin[XENO:n ]
Lair has been occupied by Antols.

You need to defeat the Chilkin and Antol leaders[XENO:n ]
to maintain the ecological balance of Valak Mountain.
Defeat [System:Color name=item ]Barbaric Sitri[/System:Color] in the Antol Den.

Defeat [System:Color name=item ]Banquet Vassago[/System:Color] who is somewhere in[XENO:n ]
Valak Mountain.
Return to Dakuku.

The war between the Antols and Chilkins is over[XENO:n ]
and balance is restored to Valak Mountain.

Zain has risked his life to go alone to the top of the[XENO:n ]
mountain to try and change things. Go to the top of[XENO:n ]
Valak Mountain and help him!

Talk to Zain who is somewhere on Three Sage[XENO:n ]
Summit at Valak Mountain.
Return to Krall.

Zain is safe. But what of the ruins he went up[XENO:n ]
there to investigate...?

Collect the Giants' Treasures and use them to unseal[XENO:n ]
the door to the ruins on Three Sage Summit.

Collect 3 Giants' Treasures from all around[XENO:n ]
the world.

Go to the Giants' ruins at Three Sage Summit[XENO:n ]
on Valak Mountain.

The door to the ruins on Three Sage Summit[XENO:n ]
is open. Inside a great power rests.

Collect the Giants' treasures scattered around the[XENO:n ]
world. You don't know where they are or who has[XENO:n ]
them, but researchers may be a good place to start...
Collect the [System:Color name=item ]Truth of the Giants[/System:Color].
Collect the [System:Color name=item ]Daring of the Giants[/System:Color].
Collect the [System:Color name=item ]Heart of the Giants[/System:Color].

You have collected the three treasures of the[XENO:n ]
Giants. You should be able to open the door now.

Clear the monsters so there is a safe route to the[XENO:n ]
Research Team on Valak Mountain.
Defeat 2 [System:Color name=item ]Monta Moramoras[/System:Color] on Valak Mountain.

You completed the Nopon Merchant's request.[XENO:n ]
The route to the Research Team is safer now.

You completed the Nopon Merchant's request.[XENO:n ]

You completed the Nopon Merchant's request.[XENO:n ]

Clear the monsters so there is a safe route to the[XENO:n ]
Research Team on Valak Mountain.
Defeat 1 [System:Color name=item ]Sesna Lexos[/System:Color] on Valak Mountain.

You completed the Nopon Merchant's request.[XENO:n ]
The route to the Research Team is safer now.

The door to the tower that Alvis spoke of is covered in[XENO:n ]
ice. You could melt it with a Magma Rock which is[XENO:n ]
found near a geyser in a cave on Valak Mountain.

Collect a [System:Color name=item ]Magma Rock[/System:Color] from a cave near[XENO:n ]
a geyser.

Use the [System:Color name=item ]Magma Rock[/System:Color] to melt the ice covering[XENO:n ]
the door.
You melted the ice covering the door.
